crossRefs.note: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
If one man sins against another, God will judge him; but if a man sins against Yahweh, who will intercede for him?”…
Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
“Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing…

translations.web: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
translations.bsb: A wise son heeds his father’s discipline, but a mocker does not listen to rebuke.
translations.kjv: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
translations.asv: A wise son heareth his father's instruction; But a scoffer heareth not rebuke.
